RICH COLOR & VARIATION - Our premium bulk seaglass pieces are a recycled manufactured product made of broken and tumbled glass. They feature a light frosted finish and a variation of rich tinted color to resemble surf tumbled sea glass
GREAT FOR HOME DÉCOR - Create a unique seaside accent to your coastal and nautical décor by pairing with sand dollars, real finger or knobby starfish, and a white shell mix
PERFECT FOR ARTS & CRAFTS - Craft ideas include: vase filler, sea glass ornaments, sea glass and shell mirror, candle surround, jewelry, picture frames, bowls, and more
EVENT DECOR - Incorporate this unique colored sea glass into your beach wedding, nautical party, or coastal event as an eye-catching decorative accent
